title.desc: Question displayed above the control (also `title` on the schema property), translated with `t()` and rendered as inline markdown, with the `*` of a required control. `label: false` hides it.

description.desc: Text under the title (also `description` on the schema property), translated with `t()` and rendered as markdown.

label.desc: Label inside the input (also `label` on the schema property): floating label of an input or select, text of a toggle, upload button... Plain text, translated with `t()`. `false` hides the title.

hint.desc: Help text under the input (also `hint` on the schema property), translated with `t()` and rendered as markdown; the error messages replace it.

titleClass.desc: CSS classes added to the title (`q-form-title`).

descriptionClass.desc: CSS classes added to the description (`q-form-description`).

hintClass.desc: CSS classes added to the hint (`q-form-hint`).

class.desc: CSS classes set on the root element of the control (Quasar grid classes such as `col-md-6` work inside a layout with `row`).

readonly.desc: Render the control read-only (`readOnly` is accepted too). Also `readOnly` in the schema, or the `readonly` prop of `QJsonForm`.

format.desc: Select a renderer when the schema `format` is not set (`radio`, `checkbox`, `images`, `slider`, `range`, `rating`, `typeahead`, `markdown`, `datepicker`...).

validationMessage.desc: Message of the renderer-level checks, translated with `t()`: a string applies to every check of the control; in a map, `default` is the fallback of the named messages (`validationMessage.wordLimitError`...).

languages.desc: Languages of a localized string control, `['en', 'fr']` or `{ en: 'English' }`; defaults to `config.languages`, then the `languages` prop of `QJsonForm`.
